deterministic_acceptance.limitation: The fake function_tool decorator accepted output_type and output_json_schema together and therefore did not model the installed SDK mutual-exclusion contract.

confirmed_root_cause.product_behavior: build_sdk_function_tool passed both output_type and output_json_schema.
confirmed_root_cause.upstream_contract: output_type and output_json_schema cannot both be provided.
confirmed_root_cause.failure_phase: FunctionTool construction before Agent/LLM lifecycle hooks

correction.strategy: Bind output_type only; let the SDK generate the strict output schema and validate the Tool result from the Pydantic model.
